selection: All five Saleor training candidates/all discovery statuses including two null categories; three mechanical families with nested/outer overlap.
interpretation: Three missing-context, one nonrepair exclusion and one security-boundary deferral. Empty explicit optional String falls back to cookie while caller skips CSRF; csrf_exempt form-POST and Secure/SameSite=None issuance establish conditional ambient credential use without the required binding. Lax/third-party blocking and response readability remain qualified; no automatic token-theft/account-takeover claim. Cleaner already rejects empty actual tokens and only changes missing/invalid classification; preserve its null nonrepair exclusion. JWT setup messages do not establish sensitive other-user disclosure, and new typed branch is not the separately fixed generic formatter or all-subclass enum certification. MANAGE_USERS-only actor can reach another customer root; old root-ID orders loader/callback returns non-drafts without MANAGE_ORDERS/ownership. Nested/outer one overlapping mechanism, not two issues. Four pins retain149 inert texts/six exact peers/three resolved parents/six complete context archive inventories plus three old delivery searches and explicit absent paths. Locked-era PyJWT2.5.0/Graphene2.1.9/Django3.2.18/3.2.25 are semantic comparisons, not installed/all-version/browser proof. Preserve all833 ledger events/statuses/categories/hashes/families, canonical bytes/splits, prior authored batches and45 protected inputs. Five functions/three families are not independent issue counts; no retained program, payload, vulnerability request or upstream test executes.

reviews.contract_reason: Old perform_mutation sets need_csrf only when argument is None, then old helper uses falsey fallback to refreshToken cookie. Graphene String accepts the empty string, so explicit empty input selects an ambient valid cookie without clean_csrf_token. Public mutation docs require CSRF when credential comes from the cookie. Matched route is csrf_exempt, POST view accepts form-encoded queries, and configured refresh middleware emits HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=None when DEBUG=False; DEBUG=True instead uses Lax. Caller validates cookie JWT/user, issues an access token and updates last_login. Thus no attacker reading the HttpOnly cookie is required for credential use, but browser cookie admission and actual request/user state still matter.

reviews.security_reason: Under an accepted Secure/SameSite=None valid refresh cookie and actual cross-site POST delivery, an attacker-controlled empty explicit argument can induce cookie-authorized token issuance/last_login update without the required CSRF value. Third-party-cookie blocking or DEBUG Lax can prevent that cross-site delivery. Returned access-token theft/account takeover additionally needs response-readability/CORS or another exfiltration path; that is not established here. The demonstrated boundary is ambient credential use without the documented CSRF binding, not universal token disclosure.

Empty string stays explicit and is rejected by JWT payload decoding instead of using the cookie; cleaner change alters missing versus invalid error classification. None still requires a matching CSRF value for a cookie credential; a valid explicit refresh token remains an explicit credential route by design. Negative covers the empty-argument/cookie mismatch only, not every CSRF/JWT/browser/CORS/last-login behavior. No supported after-contract regression is established.

reviews.contract_reason: Old public AccountQueries.user resolver admits MANAGE_USERS independently of MANAGE_ORDERS, and resolve_user returns customer roots for a requestor holding that permission. The selected orders field is not protected by the nearby events-field decorator. OrdersByUserLoader queries by root user ID and returns those order objects. Old callback only filters drafts for non-order-managers and performs no ownership check, so an authenticated actor with customer-management permission but not order-management permission can request another customer root and receive its non-draft orders.
